look.extra: bone-white crest #e8e0d0 with emissive edge, red eye glow, screech pitched down 30%

telegraph.notes: second arrow appears 0.6 s after the first; both track then lock

attacks.counter: Sidestep the first arrow, then the second; stand in front of a crate stack so a pounce ends in it.

mapRules: A pounce that ends in a crate (C) breaks that stack (cells become floor) and stuns Razorback 2.5 s at +50% damage taken.
Captured turrets always target Razorback (floor 5 script).
Fence posts idle in this phase.

attacks.counter: Dash across the third arrow, not along it.
Kill the pair on the ice-free lanes before the next chain.

mapRules: The four fence posts start cycling (5 s on / 3 s off, floor 5 script).
A pounce that crosses a live fence stops at the fence: stun 3 s and 8 RH.

attacks.counter: Move on the first flicker; keep a fence between you and it.
Never stand where it lands; dash out of the cone, then punish.

mapRules: Crate and fence stuns still apply.

rewards.note: Zone boss: Sentry Drone joins the drop pool on first clear; featured-hero shards per roster.

look.extra: glowing orange cracks #ff6a1a (emissive), ember particles, sparks when bullets hit the front; glows white while armour is stripped

attacks.counter: Stand with a slag pool or a falling press behind you and sidestep the lane; shoot its back while it recovers.

mapRules: Dunk: a charge that ends in slag (*) deals 24 RH (15% max HP), ignites it 4 s (2 RH/s) and strips the front armour for 6 s. Bosses never die in slag.
A charge through a 'y' press cell while that press falls stuns it 3 s.
Presses run on the floor 5 script (every 4 s, alternating halves).

attacks.counter: Same baits; the presses are faster now, so time the bait to the 2 s beat.
Do not kite back along its path; fire is 12 HP/s.

mapRules: Presses double speed: every 2 s (floor 5 script).

attacks.counter: Keep baiting into slag.
Move out of the circles the moment its charge ends.

mapRules: Dunk and press stun still apply; slag trail continues.

onDeath.effect: molten burst; leaves fire on 4 cells for 6 s

rewards.note: Zone boss: Overcharge joins the drop pool on first clear; star 3 counts dunks.

look.extra: pale yellow pus sacs #d8e070 (Bloater pus recoloured), 6 Spore Pod meshes on its back that inflate on the spore telegraph

attacks.counter: Shoot pods while they grow (1.5 s); auto-fire only takes them when no enemy is in range.
Dash through its trail to scorch it: it heals 2% max HP/s (3.4 RH/s) standing on creep.

mapRules: Walks a slow figure-eight through the four paths.
Regenerates 2% max HP/s on creep; scorched cells do not count.

attacks.counter: Step out of the 6 m ring before it inflates, or clear the cloud with an explosion.
Keep the pod count down.

mapRules: Inside its cloud only its eye glints show.

attacks.counter: Clear the eggs on the paths before it reaches 30%.

telegraph.notes: veins pulse along the four paths

attacks.counter: Scorch the tendrils; they feed its regen.
Pods near it are its weak point.

mapRules: Wilt: destroying the four pods nearest to it makes it wilt 5 s (damage taken x2). The count resets after each wilt.
All egg clusters hatch on phase start (floor 5 script, HATCH_ALL).

onDeath.effect: all creep recedes (1 cell per 0.5 s); living pods burst

rewards.note: Zone boss: Incendiary Rounds joins the drop pool on first clear.

look.extra: no texture detail, pale pink emissive eyes (always visible glints), cyan sparks on a grate, blue glow while stunned

telegraph.notes: always visible, even in the dark

attacks.counter: Watch for the red arrow; fight near a lit pylon or stick a flare on it to expose it (double damage).

mapRules: Invisible outside light (eye glints only). Takes x2 damage while lit by a flare or pylon.

attacks.counter: Same as phase 1.
Relight it (stand 1.5 s) and keep another pylon lit as backup.

mapRules: Smashed pylons can be relit (1.5 s).

telegraph.notes: generator wind-down sound, lights dim over 1 s

attacks.counter: Use the 3 fresh flares: stick one on it.
Stand so the third pounce lands on a live grate.

mapRules: A pounce that lands on a live grate (g) stuns it 3 s and lights it (exposed, x2 damage, glows blue).
Pylons go off on phase start (floor 5 script) and can be relit.

onDeath.effect: lights restore across the hall

rewards.note: Act I finale: first clear opens Act II and grants the Flare Pack.

look.extra: legs hidden under the water plane, cyan emissive gill slits #5fd8ff, white-blue splash particles on surfacing

attacks.counter: Step off the ring onto dry ground, then unload while it is up for 3 s.
It surfaces at the pool rim nearest you; shoot it there.

mapRules: Untargetable while submerged; a wake trail shows where it is.
Pool terminals (R): each switches the grates to always on for 5 s, then re-arms after 15 s (floor 5 script).
Submerged in an electrified pool: forced up, stunned 3 s, takes 18 RH (10% max HP).

attacks.counter: Fight from the dry blue-zone corners; dash is never slowed by water.
Keep moving between globs; they land where you stood.

mapRules: Pool terminals (R): each switches the grates to always on for 5 s, then re-arms after 15 s (floor 5 script).
Submerged in an electrified pool: forced up, stunned 3 s, takes 18 RH (10% max HP).

attacks.counter: Dash sideways out of the lane.
As phase 2.

mapRules: Pool terminals (R): each switches the grates to always on for 5 s, then re-arms after 15 s (floor 5 script).
Submerged in an electrified pool: forced up, stunned 3 s, takes 18 RH (10% max HP).

onDeath.effect: water recedes one depth step

rewards.note: Zone boss: Bulwark joins the drop pool on first clear; Cryo Rounds freeze water.

bosses.name: Hullbreaker

look.extra: squashed to 0.6x height; hazard-yellow #f2c230 emissive strip; two cargo crates at 0.35x tinted #1f7a7a bolted on its back as plates (fall off in Phase 3); a crane hook (a crate at 0.2x) on a line-renderer cable from its back

attacks.counter: Keep a crate or container between you and it: the hook catches the box, and it spends 2 s hauling (takes +50% damage).

effect.leaves: C at the end of the swing

attacks.counter: Step out of the cone; the swung box lands as a new crate.

mapRules: Crane STRIKE drops 2 containers every 10 s (leaves C): new things for it to hook.
Every hauled box is left beside it, so the bay rebuilds around the boss.

attacks.counter: Keep a crate or container between you and it: the hook catches the box, and it spends 2 s hauling (takes +50% damage).

attacks.requires: a container or C crate within 4 m
attacks.counter: Leave the red circle; the box becomes a new crate.
Kill the Ticks before they latch.

attacks.trigger: a turret is captured by the hero
attacks.counter: Stand on the turret ring while it yanks: the turret holds and it is stuck pulling for 2 s.

mapRules: Turrets come online; a captured turret is the bait that pins it for 2 s.

attacks.counter: Keep a crate or container between you and it: the hook catches the box, and it spends 2 s hauling (takes +50% damage).
Enrage: two hooks back to back; the second aims where the first pulled you.

mapRules: All belts run north into the press line.
A hook that catches nothing in 16 m roots it for 2.5 s; rooted on a belt it is carried into the press: 25 RH per slam and its plates break.

onDeath.effect: collapses; its two plates fall off as C crates

bosses.rewards: Zone boss table: featured-hero shards, Scavenger/Bulwark set gear, first clear +10 Cores.

bosses.name: Mire Matriarch

look.extra: Spitter placeholder; toxic #9bff3a emissive abdomen sphere 1.8x the Spitter's; crown of six Lancer spikes; dripping green particle trail

attacks.counter: Globs land where you were: strafe sideways, roofs (u) block them.
Follow the safe path; stand on it until the field fades.

attacks.trigger: acid-rain warning (3 s before each pulse)
attacks.counter: Push her: she backs off at 10 m, so walk her away from the roof before the siren.

mapRules: Rain pulses (every 20 s) hit her for 3 RH per 0.5 s tick while she is outside cover; she shrieks.
She keeps 10-14 m away and backs off when the hero pushes in.

attacks.counter: As Phase 1.
Read the green ring on the target pool and shoot the spore pod there before she surfaces.

mapRules: Dives only between a cells (the six acid pools).
A Spore Pod sprouts beside each surfacing pool.

attacks.counter: As Phase 1.
Keep a roof between you and her line; the rain hurts her when she is in the open.

attacks.trigger: she stands under a roof for 3 s
attacks.counter: Bait her into roofs that are already melting so she loses her shelter.

mapRules: She calls the rain herself every 10 s.
Corroded roofs fall like the Monsoon floor.

bosses.rewards: Zone boss table: featured-hero shards, Hivebreaker/Scavenger set gear, first clear +10 Cores.

bosses.name: WARDEN-9

look.extra: red emissive visor #ff3355, purple creep veins #b04dff on the limbs, Vanguard minigun at 2.0x, three red line renderers to a turret while hacking

attacks.counter: Break line with a rack or crate before the cone locks.
Recapture the red turret (2.5 s): it then hunts WARDEN-9 at 3x damage.

mapRules: Racks and crates block the sweep.
It hacks one neutral turret every 15 s.

attacks.counter: As Phase 1.
Move between quadrants in the 3 s gaps; lure it across the grate cross on the pulse.

mapRules: Walks through fences unharmed but takes 6 RH/s on a live grate like any enemy.
Chases the hero: the central grate cross is the damage window.
Breaker (breaker=GRATE) kills the grates: safety for the hero, a free floor for WARDEN-9.

attacks.counter: The red cone still shows in the dark.
Cross only in the 2 s gaps; lure it onto the grate cross while the fences pin you in its quadrant.

mapRules: Lights stay on; the pylons are unused.
Fences hurt the hero (25 HP + shove); WARDEN-9 walks through them.

onDeath.effect: powers down and kneels; the core floats out

bosses.rewards: Zone boss table: featured-hero shards, Volt/Bulwark set gear, +3 Weapon Parts from the core, first clear +10 Cores.

bosses.name: The Surgeon

look.extra: Mender placeholder; mint #7fd8a6 emissive sac; four thin Lancer spikes as scalpels; three green tether lines at once

attacks.counter: Burn or freeze its targets (fire and ice block healing); a vent eruption cancels the current tether.
Kill the Drones near it first so it has nothing to drink.

mapRules: Regrows any hive wall it is tethered to instantly when shot down.
Vents deal double damage to it (8 RH/s) and cancel its current tether.

attacks.counter: Explosions x3 on the cocoon; kill the two Menders before they tether.
As Phase 1.

mapRules: The cocoon is a hive wall (m) that does not regrow.

onDeath.effect: tethered walls stop regrowing for 12 s

bosses.rewards: Mini-boss: guaranteed power-up drop and an elite gear roll.

bosses.name: Patient Zero

look.extra: creep veins #b04dff pulsing; a Bloater mesh at 0.8x fused on the back (purple emissive pus); torn translucent hospital sheeting on one arm

attacks.counter: Step out of the cone, then scorch the creep it leaves (dash, barrels, Incendiary).

mapRules: Creep under it heals it 2% max HP/s (5.2 RH/s), the zone's SPREAD rule.
A vent eruption that hits it stuns it for 1.5 s.

attacks.counter: As Phase 1.
Step off the lines; shoot through a wall (explosions x3) to keep the fight in one room, or clear the eggs.

mapRules: Vents in its quarter erupt on its own cycle; a vent hit stuns it 1.5 s.

attacks.counter: As Phase 1.
Kill both Menders first: until then it takes half damage.

mapRules: Centre creep grows 3x faster.
Vents run 4 s cycles.

onDeath.effect: collapses into a hive wall statue (2x2 m, permanent)

bosses.rewards: Zone boss table: featured-hero shards, Hivebreaker/Bulwark set gear, first clear +15 Cores.

bosses.name: Highwire

look.extra: Lancer placeholder; gold elite rim; three back spikes; cyan spark trail while on grates

attacks.counter: Break the line with a housing; lightning cannot reach it under a roof, so flush it out.
Shoot the breaker (breaker=GRATE) to make it killable, at the cost of the grates.
Stand downwind of it: the gust brings it to you.

mapRules: Flees up and down the switchbacks; stops only under roofs.
Escort summons every 10 s are Lancer pairs.

attacks.counter: The decoy has no gold eye glints; ignore it.
As Phase 1.

mapRules: Same as Phase 1.

onDeath.effect: ends the ASSASSINATE floor

bosses.rewards: Mini-boss: guaranteed power-up drop and an elite gear roll; 60 s kill pays the ASSASSINATE bonus.

bosses.name: The Arc Matron

look.extra: Weaver recipe; dark purple joints; cyan #5fd8ff emissive abdomen that sparks when lightning lands within 6 m; strands are cyan Weaver tracer cylinders

attacks.counter: Shoot strands (3 RH) or let a gust snap the ones parallel to it; never stand on a strand when lightning lands.

mapRules: Lightning that hits a strand arcs along it (15 HP to the hero, 6 RH to enemies).
Wind gusts break strands parallel to the gust.

attacks.trigger: phase start, and again after each fall
attacks.counter: Shoot the breaker: on a dead pylon the strike hits her (12 RH, 2 s fall stun) instead of healing her.
Kill the Lancers from under a roof.
As Phase 1.

mapRules: Every pylon has a grate under it; the breaker (breaker=GRATE) drops all four.

attacks.counter: Burn or shoot your way into a roof and fight from under it.
Drag her through the open: the storm (lightning every 3 s) hits her too, 12 RH a strike.

mapRules: Gusts every 8 s push toward the pit corners; lightning every 3 s.

onDeath.effect: the storm breaks: lightning and wind stop, sunlight floods the platform

bosses.rewards: Zone boss table: featured-hero shards, Volt/Overclock set gear, first clear +15 Cores.

look.extra: orange emissive front, three Lancer spikes on its back, pale cyan streak particles trailing off the shell (wind-blasted)

attacks.effect: railings (r) it hits break and open that edge to the void instead of stunning it
attacks.counter: Stand with an open edge behind you and sidestep the third charge; it stops stunned at the lip.
Step between the six lines; they fan from its back.

attacks.trigger: WIND gust while stunned within 2 m of an open edge
attacks.effect: hangs on the lip 4 s (LEDGE: x2 damage taken, cannot act); above 30% HP it climbs back, at or below 30% it falls and dies
attacks.counter: Wait for the gust arrow while it is stunned at the edge, then unload.

mapRules: Railings break on its charge, so every charge permanently opens more void edges.
Gusts push it like any boss (4 m/s) only while it is stunned.

attacks.effect: the two Carapaces charge along the cart rail
attacks.counter: Step off the rail line; gusts push them off the 1-cell bridge.

mapRules: The 30% LEDGE kill threshold makes this phase the window for a void kill.

onDeath.effect: shell fragments; if it died by falling, full biomass and the 'Blown Away' callout

rewards.note: Mini-boss: guaranteed power-up drop and 30 biomass; counts for the void-kill bonus challenge.

look.extra: white streak tint on the back, cyan emissive eyes #4fd2ff; the snapped cable is a stretched tether-material cylinder with the tracer trail

attacks.effect: red arrow from boss to circle; lands on the hero's ring; every crumbling cell (k) under the circle falls
attacks.counter: Leave the circle; take the jump pad when it commits to your ring so it lands on bare crumbling cells.
Stay out of melee range between pounces.

mapRules: Landings crack spokes: each pounce removes k cells, so the ring links shrink over the fight.
LEDGE: a gust or a jump-pad landing shove that leaves it within 1 m of a pit lip makes it hang 4 s at x2 damage (once per 15 s). It never falls.

attacks.effect: a whipping cable sweeps the line; enemies on it are shoved 4 m (pits kill them)
attacks.counter: Cross the yellow line before it locks; lure packs onto it.

attacks.effect: each landing drops 2 Leaper pups (Leaper at 0.6x, 2 RH)
attacks.counter: Shoot pups near pit lips; one gust clears them.

mapRules: Pups pounce gaps like Leapers (3 cells).

attacks.effect: roar, then a WIND gust (4 m/s, 3 s) toward the nearest pit from the hero
attacks.counter: Get a block between you and the gust, or dash through it.

attacks.effect: pounces only across pits
attacks.counter: Bait the pounce, then jump-pad away so it lands on crumbling cells near a lip.

mapRules: The boss chooses the gust direction (floor script: WEATHER period 7).

onDeath.effect: falls from the crown into the cloud sea, scream fades with Doppler pitch-down

rewards.note: Ledge bonus: 3 LEDGE states in one fight completes star 3.

look.extra: ship's white deck markings as a stripe decal, amber emissive front #ffb347

attacks.effect: downhill x1.35 speed, uphill x0.7; a downhill charge into a bulkhead stuns 4 s (2.5 s otherwise); breaking a crate sets it on fire (fire seed)
attacks.counter: Stand downhill with a block at your back and dodge; it stuns itself for 4 s.
Step off the charge lane right after it passes.

mapRules: Targets the DEFEND core (G) first.
A captured turret within 10 m pulls it away from the core 50% of the time.
Slope from the floor's DRIFT direction sets its charge speed.

onDeath.effect: armour plates scatter

rewards.note: Mini-boss: guaranteed power-up drop and 30 biomass.

look.extra: creep veins (#b04dff emissive) on the shoulders, red-violet visor, minigun muzzle flash recoloured violet

attacks.counter: Dash across the cone or break line of sight behind crates.

attacks.effect: kicks a barrel downhill; it rolls and explodes (barrel rules)
attacks.counter: Step off the yellow line; shoot the barrel early when it rolls into a pack.

mapRules: Walks the command deck behind the railings.
Barrels rolled from the uphill wall deal x3 damage to him.

attacks.effect: stomp ring, then a 3 s overdrive cone (60 deg, 14 m) with knockback; knockback plus drift pushes the hero downhill into the fire cells
attacks.counter: Attack from the side of the cone, never from below; dash across it.

mapRules: Uses DRIFT: his knockback is always aimed downhill.

attacks.effect: captures every turret within 10 m (they go red and fire at the hero) and seeds fire on the carpeted upper bridge (p)
attacks.counter: Recapture turrets (2.5 s): a hero turret deals x3 damage to him and is the only way to strip his 50% damage reduction.

mapRules: Takes 50% damage except from turrets the hero owns (x3) and rolling barrels (x3).

onDeath.effect: drops to one knee, minigun spins down; the Valiant's PA goes silent

look.extra: glowing yellow-green core stripe #c8ff3a down the back, blue Cherenkov point light under the belly

attacks.effect: every cell it touches becomes q (radiation) for 10 s
attacks.counter: Never fight on its trail.
Lure the charge into the reactor block: 3 s stun with the back exposed.

mapRules: A steam vent erupting under it cracks its shell: front armour off for 5 s and a 1 s stagger.

attacks.counter: Stand between rings or dash through one as it passes.

attacks.effect: heals 1 RH/s for every q cell within 3 m
attacks.counter: Turn the valve for its quarter (purge, cooldown 20 s) to stop the heal.

mapRules: Four valves (R) purge one quarter of the arena each.

attacks.counter: Same reactor-block bait, now every 4 s.

attacks.effect: reactor fire FRONT from the north at 1.0 m/s that stops at the reactor block (floor script)
attacks.counter: Complete a valve to pause the front 4 s; fight in the southern half.

mapRules: Enraged: speed 0.8x.

onDeath.effect: vents all its radiation: every q cell on the floor fades over 3 s

rewards.note: Killing blow inside a vent eruption completes star 3.

bosses.name: Tunnel Matron
bosses.basedOn: mender (Grand Mender elite, ASSASSINATE x4 HP)

look.extra: Mender look: swollen green emissive sac, gold elite rim, faint white mist trail

attacks.effect: flees to the far side at 1.1x; passes through hive walls (they open for her and regrow behind)
attacks.counter: Shoot the hive wall ahead of her: she waits 1 s for it to regrow.

attacks.effect: they surface between her and the hero
attacks.counter: Keep moving; shoot through the gap after they surface.

attacks.effect: heals every nest and egg cluster within 6 m by 1 RH/s; Grand Mender aura heals allies 1 RH/s in 6 m
attacks.counter: Kill her before she reaches the egg fields.

mapRules: Exposed (+20% damage taken) while in pylon or flare light.
In the dark only her eye glints and her green tether to the nearest escort show.
A flare thrown within 1 m sticks to her for 12 s.

onDeath.effect: sac bursts; nearby eggs stop being healed

rewards.note: ASSASSINATE target: kill within 60 s for the bonus (and star 3).

look.extra: Stalker cyan emissive slit #4fd2ff; cloaked 12% alpha with scrolling noise; decoys 8% alpha, no eye glints

attacks.effect: de-cloak hiss and a white blade arc from behind
attacks.counter: Stand in pylon light and let it come; a flare on its de-cloak sticks and reveals it 8 s.

mapRules: Targetable only inside light (pylons, flares, hero light); takes +20% in pylon light.

attacks.effect: smashes the nearest lit pylon; 6 RH of damage during the telegraph interrupts it
attacks.counter: Burst it during the yellow line, or relight the pylon (1.5 s stand).

attacks.trigger: when its path crosses a hive wall
attacks.effect: hive wall explodes outward
attacks.counter: Don't hold position next to hive walls.

mapRules: Pylons (I) become destructible by it and relightable by the hero.

attacks.effect: two shadow decoys (Shade Stalker rule, 1 hit each, 14 damage strikes); only the real one has eye glints; every egg hatches (floor script)
attacks.counter: Area damage (grenade, Shock Trail, explosions) reveals all three; watch for the eye glints.

mapRules: The central d ring never lights: never fight it there.

onDeath.effect: cloak fails in a white flash; every pylon on the floor relights

look.extra: violet emissive sac #b04dff on its back, trails creep decals

attacks.effect: walks the cart track; every cell it touches becomes a creep seed (1 per s), which stops the Torch cart
attacks.counter: Fire stops its seeding for 3 s; burn the track behind it.

attacks.effect: grows a ring of 4 hive walls (10 RH each) around a random enemy, shielding it
attacks.counter: Explosions deal x3 to hive walls; or ignore the shielded enemy.

attacks.effect: heals nests within 8 m by 1 RH/s
attacks.counter: Pull it away from nests.

mapRules: Takes x2 damage while standing on scorched floor: burn a patch ahead of it and wait.

onDeath.effect: every creep cell it seeded recedes 1 per 3 s

rewards.note: Mini-boss: guaranteed power-up drop (Incendiary weighted x2) and 30 biomass.

bosses.name: The Choir
bosses.basedOn: hive_linked trio: Warcry Shrieker, Grand Mender, Marksman Lancer

look.extra: the three enemy placeholders at 1.6x, gold elite rims, one violet tether line linking them in a triangle

attacks.effect: 4-hit shield on every ally within 8 m
attacks.counter: Kill the shield carriers with area damage; the shields pop on Shrieker death (shared pool).

attacks.effect: heals the pool 3 RH and revives the last dead Drone
attacks.counter: Burst damage between mends.
Move sideways; the fan is 10 degrees wide.

mapRules: All three within 8 m of each other: immune to knockback. Split them and they can be shoved.
One member falling into a pit kills the whole Choir (shared pool).

onDeath.effect: the tether snaps with a choir chord

rewards.note: Mini-boss: guaranteed power-up drop and 40 biomass.

look.extra: 1.8x stretched abdomen, crown of six bone-white Lancer spikes, violet emissive veins; phase 4 adds cracked amber glow #ffb070 in her seams

attacks.counter: Grenade or Shock Trail on the clutch as it lands.
Never stand behind her.

attacks.effect: cracks the nearest crumbling chitin cell (k)
attacks.counter: Stay off the ring she is slamming next to.

mapRules: Egg sacs (4, 15 RH) hatch 3 Ticks every 12 s.
Enemies shoved off the ring fall.
Every slam cracks the nearest k cell.

attacks.counter: Stand behind a pillar (B).

mapRules: Pillars block the barrage.

attacks.trigger: end of the 8 s burrow, under the hero
attacks.counter: Keep moving during the burrow; dash out of the ring.

mapRules: Swarm Call: two waves pour in while she is underground.

attacks.effect: the crumbling ring around the inner arena falls into the void cell by cell, outward from her, over 4 s; the jump pad is the only link to the outer ring
attacks.counter: Be on the inner island (or the jump pad) when the cracks reach you.

attacks.effect: one creep tick around her, cap 3 cells per tick
attacks.counter: Dash lines and explosions scorch it.

attacks.effect: leaps to the outer ring through the jump pad, which breaks; the last 10% is fought across the void
attacks.counter: Long-range fire; dodge her barrage across the gap.

mapRules: Ledge Teeter: an explosion, a Barrage knockback or her own missed Tail Sweep that leaves her within 1 m of the island lip makes her teeter 3 s at x2 damage (once per 12 s).
She never falls.

onDeath.effect: the spire breaks: 15 s victory-lap OUTRUN to the lift with a harmless creep FRONT behind; credits roll from the lift

rewards.note: Final boss: 'Swarm Breaker' title on first clear.

look.extra: red emissive lerp in phase 2
stretched Bloater abdomen 1.6x long pulsing; violet egg sacs
Carapace placeholder at 1.6x, bright orange emissive, 3 Lancer spikes on shell
Spitter placeholder at 2.2x, abdomen sphere 1.5x, crown of Lancer spikes
column of 4 stacked Bloaters (1.6/1.4/1.2/1.0), red emissive mouth ring, Burrower dust 3x
purple emissive veins, hovering 1.5 m over a pedestal; purple Bulwark shield at 4 m
